measures.name: Revenue YOY %
measures.expression:
VAR Current_Year_Revenue = [Gross Revenue]
 VAR Previous_Year_Revenue = CALCULATE([Gross Revenue], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Dim_Date[Date]))
 RETURN
    DIVIDE(Current_Year_Revenue - Previous_Year_Revenue, Previous_Year_Revenue, BLANK())

measures.name: Revenue TTM
measures.expression:
VAR selectedMonth = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Month])
VAR selectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Year])

Var currentYear = YEAR(TODAY())
var currentMonth = MONTH(TODAY())

VAR endDate = IF(
    selectedYear >= currentYear && selectedMonth >= currentMonth,
    EOMONTH(TODAY(), -1),
    EOMONTH(DATE(selectedYear,selectedMonth,1),0)
)

VAR startDate = EDATE(endDate,-11)

RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(selectedMonth) && ISBLANK(selectedYear),
        BLANK(),
        CALCULATE(
            [Gross Revenue],
            FILTER(
                ALL(Dim_Date[Date]),
                Dim_Date[Date] >= startDate && Dim_Date[Date] <= endDate
            )
        )
    )

measures.name: New Customers
measures.expression:
VAR selectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Year])
VAR selectedMonth = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Month])
VAR windowStart = DATE(selectedYear, selectedMonth, 1)
VAR windowEnd = EOMONTH(windowStart, 0)
VAR customersThisMonth =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(gold_sales_summary[CustomerKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(Dim_Date),
            Dim_Date[Date] >= windowStart && Dim_Date[Date] <= windowEnd
        )
    )
VAR customersBeforeThisMonth =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(gold_sales_summary[CustomerKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(Dim_Date),
            Dim_Date[Date] < windowStart
        )
    )
VAR trulyNewSet = EXCEPT(customersThisMonth, customersBeforeThisMonth)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(selectedYear) || ISBLANK(selectedMonth),
        BLANK(),
        COUNTROWS(trulyNewSet)
    )

measures.name: Rolling Active Customers
measures.expression:
VAR selectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Year])
VAR selectedMonth = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Month])
VAR currentYear = YEAR(TODAY())
VAR currentMonth = MONTH(TODAY())
VAR endDate = IF(
    selectedYear >= currentYear && selectedMonth >= currentMonth,
    EOMONTH(TODAY(), -1),
    EOMONTH(DATE(selectedYear,selectedMonth,1),0)
)
VAR startDate = EDATE(endDate,-11)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(selectedYear) || ISBLANK(selectedMonth),
        0,
        CALCULATE(
            DISTINCTCOUNT(gold_sales_summary[CustomerKey]),
            FILTER(
                ALL(Dim_Date),
                Dim_Date[Date] >= startDate && Dim_Date[Date] <= endDate
            )
        )
    )

measures.name: Lapsed Customers
measures.expression:
VAR selectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Year])
VAR selectedMonth = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Date[Month])
VAR windowStart = DATE(selectedYear, selectedMonth, 1)
VAR windowEnd = EOMONTH(windowStart, 0)
VAR priorStart = EDATE(windowStart, -1)
VAR priorEnd = EDATE(windowEnd, -1)
VAR customersThisMonth =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(gold_sales_summary[CustomerKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(Dim_Date),
            Dim_Date[Date] >= windowStart && Dim_Date[Date] <= windowEnd
        )
    )
VAR customersPriorMonth =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(gold_sales_summary[CustomerKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(Dim_Date),
            Dim_Date[Date] >= priorStart && Dim_Date[Date] <= priorEnd
        )
    )
VAR lapsedSet = EXCEPT(customersPriorMonth, customersThisMonth)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(selectedYear) || ISBLANK(selectedMonth),
        BLANK(),
        COUNTROWS(lapsedSet)
    )

        selection,
        "Revenue", [Gross Revenue],
        "Units Sold", [Unit Sold],
        "Gross Profit", [Gross Profit],

        "Transactions", [Total Transactions]

measures.name: HTML_ExecutiveSummary
measures.expression:
VAR YOY = [Revenue YOY %] VAR BudgetGap = [Revenue vs Budget BPS] VAR NetCustGrowth = [Net Customer Growth] VAR TopChannel = [Top Channel Name] VAR TopChannelRev = [Top Channel Revenue] VAR LastDates = [Last Data Date] -- Block 1 VARs: Revenue Health VAR Block1Color = SWITCH(TRUE(), NOT HASONEVALUE(Dim_Date[Year]), "#707070", ISBLANK(YOY), "#707070", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap > 0, "#1A7A4A", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap <= 0, "#B7770D", "#C0392B" ) VAR Block1Icon = SWITCH(TRUE(), NOT HASONEVALUE(Dim_Date[Year]), "◆", ISBLANK(YOY), "◆", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap > 0, "▲", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap <= 0, "◆", "▼" ) VAR Block1Label = SWITCH(TRUE(), NOT HASONEVALUE(Dim_Date[Year]), "REVENUE SIGNAL", ISBLANK(YOY), "REVENUE SIGNAL", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap > 0, "REVENUE HEALTHY", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap <= 0, "MONITOR BUDGET", "REVENUE ALERT" ) VAR Block1Message = SWITCH(TRUE(), NOT HASONEVALUE(Dim_Date[Year]), "Select a single year to view YOY comparison.", ISBLANK(YOY), "No prior year data available for comparison.", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap > 0, "Growing and ahead of budget.", YOY > 0 && BudgetGap <= 0, "Growing but below budget target.", "Declining. Immediate review recommended." ) VAR Block1Values = IF( NOT HASONEVALUE(Dim_Date[Year]) || ISBLANK(YOY), "", "YOY: " & FORMAT(ABS(YOY), "0.0%") & " | Budget Var: " & FORMAT(ABS(BudgetGap), "#,0") & " BPS" ) -- Block 2 VARs: Top Channel VAR Block2Color = "#0B6477" VAR Block2RevFormatted = IF(ISBLANK(TopChannelRev), "—", IF(TopChannelRev >= 1000000, FORMAT(TopChannelRev / 1000000, "0.0") & "M", FORMAT(TopChannelRev / 1000, "0.0") & "K" ) ) VAR Block2ChannelDisplay = IF(ISBLANK(TopChannel), "No data", TopChannel) -- Block 3 VARs: Customer Signal VAR Block3Color = IF(ISBLANK(NetCustGrowth), "#707070", IF(NetCustGrowth >= 0, "#1A7A4A", "#C0392B")) VAR Block3Icon = IF(ISBLANK(NetCustGrowth), "◆", IF(NetCustGrowth >= 0, "▲", "▼")) VAR Block3Label = IF(ISBLANK(NetCustGrowth), "CUSTOMER SIGNAL", IF(NetCustGrowth >= 0, "NET CUSTOMER GROWTH", "CUSTOMER DECLINE")) VAR Block3Message = IF(ISBLANK(NetCustGrowth), "Select year and month to view.", IF(NetCustGrowth >= 0, "New customers outpacing lapsed.", "Lapsed customers exceeding new acquisitions.")) measures.name: Top Channel Name
measures.expression:
VAR ChannelSummary =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        ALL(gold_sales_summary[ChannelName]),
        "ChannelRevenue", [Gross Revenue]
    )
VAR TopChannel = TOPN(1, ChannelSummary, [ChannelRevenue], DESC)
RETURN MAXX(TopChannel, gold_sales_summary[ChannelName])
